text: I absolutely love that a recent update now allows one to initiate an edit to a video, open a completely different app to do some other work and then come back to Photos while edit work still continues in the background and then successfully finishes once returning to Photos. It used to be that the editing process couldn't work in the background. To me this is a HUGE update. I think this indicates how much closer Android might be getting towards being a full fledged desktop system.

text:
Powerful Without Being Complicated. Google Photos is simply a much more efficient and capable photo-management app than Apple Photos for the way I use it. The tools for organizing, sorting, searching, purging, and deleting photos make managing a large photo library considerably easier and faster.

What stands out most is how intuitive it remains. At a time when many apps seem to become less intuitive as more features are added, Google Photos manages to offer broader functionality without making basic tasks unnecessarily complicated.

Powerful, practical, easy to navigate, and genuinely useful. Five stars.
title: Powerful Without Being Complicated

Update: Fixed by update 7.94.. Manual backups failing. I’ll select the photos, hit the icon to manually backup, the progress bar comes up and finishes but the photos are not backed up at the end and the check mark icon showing their backed up isn’t there. 

Fully updated app, iPhone 18 pro max. I’ve tried force closing the app. 

This is a new issue. I always do manual backups on my phone in this exact way (auto on iPad) and this is an issue I haven’t seen on either device over many years of use.

I received a developer response which was unhelpful and made it clear that whoever responded didn’t actually read or understand my issue.
title: Update: Fixed by update 7.94.
